title: The Seventh Name
description: The novices' roll hangs in the warden's niche at the foot of the east stair, as Aldous said it would. Seven names for the last midwinter, and the seventh scraped out.

stages.text: Six names for the last midwinter in Aldous's hand on the novices' roll, and a seventh scraped off the vellum with a blade. The Keepers strike a name through. Nobody scrapes one. Somebody wanted it gone, not crossed out.

Told of the scraped place, the Provost went quiet long enough for Merrit to start humming again. A Keeper's hand won't scrape a name: it's the first thing a novice is taught. The door-warden kept the roll on its peg. She'll want to see it when the chapter goes up.
At the sitting the Provost took the novices' roll down off its peg and read it to the foot, and held her thumb on the scraped place, and put it back, and said nothing aloud at all.

It was the Wakebearer's own name, scraped off by the High Keeper the night of the Snuffing so nobody could ever write them in for the giving. Down from the last landing, the Wakebearer stood at the roll with the Provost's pen and chose what the seventh place should say.
